description: This file defines the EntityInterface, a core interface for entity objects in Drupal, specifying methods for entity identification, URL generation, CRUD operations, and cache management.

methods.name: uuid
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the entity, or NULL if not available.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the entity's identifier, which can be a string, int, or NULL.

methods.name: language
methods.description: Returns the language object associated with the entity.

methods.name: isNew
methods.description: Determines if the entity is new (not yet saved).

methods.name: enforceIsNew
methods.description: Enforces the entity to be considered new, optionally forcing it with a boolean parameter.

methods.name: getEntityTypeId
methods.description: Returns the entity type ID.

methods.name: bundle
methods.description: Returns the bundle of the entity, defaulting to the entity type ID if not specified.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns the label of the entity or NULL if none is set.

methods.name: toUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL object for the entity, with optional relationship and parameters.

methods.name: toLink
methods.description: Creates a link to the entity, with optional link text, relationship, and options.

methods.name: hasLinkTemplate
methods.description: Checks if a link template exists for a given key.

methods.name: uriRelationships
methods.description: Returns an array of URI relationships supported by the entity.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an entity by ID.

methods.name: loadMultiple
methods.description: Loads multiple entities by their IDs or all if NULL.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity object with optional initial values.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the entity permanently, returning a status constant.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the entity permanently.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Acts on the entity before the presave hook, used for validation or modification.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Acts after saving, before insert or update hooks.

methods.name: preCreate
methods.description: Prepares default values before creating a new entity.

methods.name: postCreate
methods.description: Acts after entity creation but before saving.

methods.name: preDelete
methods.description: Acts before entities are deleted.

methods.name: postDelete
methods.description: Acts after entities are deleted.

methods.name: postLoad
methods.description: Acts on entities after they are loaded.

methods.name: createDuplicate
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the entity with unset identifiers.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type definition.

methods.name: referencedEntities
methods.description: Returns entities referenced by this entity.

methods.name: getOriginalId
methods.description: Returns the original ID, or NULL if not applicable.

methods.name: getCacheTagsToInvalidate
methods.description: Returns cache tags for cache invalidation.

methods.name: setOriginalId
methods.description: Sets the original ID, or NULL to prevent renames.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all property values as an array.

methods.name: getTypedData
methods.description: Returns a typed data object wrapping this entity.

methods.name: getConfigDependencyKey
methods.description: Returns the key used for configuration dependencies.

methods.name: getConfigDependencyName
methods.description: Returns the configuration dependency name.

methods.name: getConfigTarget
methods.description: Returns the configuration target identifier.

methods.name: getOriginal
methods.description: Returns the original, unchanged entity during save operations.

methods.name: setOriginal
methods.description: Sets the original, unchanged entity, optionally for performance.
